post.summary: Durably apply and audit exceptional set_champion
post.description: Fresh authenticated server admin role required. Derive actor from auth. Path ID equals body target. Deduplicate body idempotencyKey by actor and canonical payload BEFORE current-state validation. Identical replay returns the same durable receipt; changed payload with same key returns409. Commit operation, state, ledger/refunds and immutable audit atomically. No receipt before commit. Champion assignment does not imply prize payment. Nonce/timestamp replay protection remains separate. Backend must enforce the authenticated administrative role and write a durable audit record; client button visibility is not authorization.

receiptUrl.description: Owned HTTPS upload page; opening it does not confirm receipt upload.

WalletSubmission.description: Sale additionally requires bank, alias, holder, whatsapp and identification when configured. Buy ignores payout fields. Authenticated identity is server-derived.

receiptDownloadUrl.description: Authorized short-lived HTTPS receipt view/download URL.

error.description: Safe human message, no credentials or stack trace.

userId.description: Immutable API account ID returned by CustomAuth provider as Photon UserId.

authToken.description: Opaque signed ticket. Memory only; CustomAuth POST body token; never URL, remote config, room properties, PlayerPrefs or logs.

expiresAt.description: UTC expiry; recommend 2-5 minutes; client requires >5 seconds and <=24 hours.

appVersion.description: Photon GameVersion partition shared by allowed participants.

allowedRooms.description: Exact room names; empty for pre-fee identity-only tickets; no wildcards.
